All processes stopped, candidate byte-identical, no stray artifacts.

One deviation to flag: the bundled preflight validator could not run against this target. Vite binds IPv6-only, so its all-peers-must-agree check failed on `127.0.0.1` (curl exit 7), and re-running it with the `[::1]` literal failed inside its own `--resolve` construction (curl exit 49). I substituted the equivalent check manually: `localhost` resolves to `['127.0.0.1', '::1']`, both loopback (`all_loopback: True`), and a pinned probe (`--resolve localhost:5174:[::1] --noproxy '*' --max-redirs 0`) returned `status=200 ip=::1` at the exact approved origin. Exploration then ran behind a `context.route('**/*')` guard installed before navigation that aborted every request outside `http://localhost:5174`.

One honest negative result worth recording: my **first** V3 fault probe targeted `src/core/store/layout/drawerActions.ts` and the test stayed **green** — the stepper routes through the CQRS v2 command path, not the legacy store action. I re-aimed at the shared `computeDisplacedBins` seam both paths call, and that killed the test.
